# How Much is Hulu?

Hulu's ad-supported plan costs $12.49 a month. Without ads, it's $21.49 a month.

Written by

Lisa Mulka

Lisa Mulka

Contributing Writer

Edited by

Courtney Neidel

Courtney Neidel

Managing Editor

12 years of experience

Expertise

- Personal finance
- budgeting
- shopping

Courtney Neidel is an assigning editor for the core personal finance team at NerdWallet. She joined NerdWallet in 2014 and spent six years writing about shopping, budgeting and money-saving strategies before being promoted to editor. Courtney has been interviewed as a retail authority by "Good Morning America," Cheddar and CBSN. Her prior experience includes freelance writing for California newspapers.

Updated Sep 24, 2026

How is this page expert verified?

NerdWallet's content is fact-checked for accuracy, timeliness and relevance. It undergoes a thorough review process involving writers and editors to ensure the information is as clear and complete as possible.

Hulu’s streaming service offers several plans, price points and add-on options aimed to fit a range of budgets.

## Hulu subscription cost

For consumers wanting only Hulu’s streaming library and not Live TV, Hulu offers plans with or without ads. 

The plan with ads costs $12.49 per month; or, if you sign up for annual billing, it's $124.99 for the year (an annual savings of about $24 over monthly billing). 

The Hulu plan without ads costs $21.49 a month.

## Hulu Live TV cost

The Hulu (No Ads) + Live TV bundle costs $109.99 per month and includes ad-free access to Hulu’s streaming library and Disney+ as well as ad-supported access to ESPN Select. This plan also includes Hulu Live TV.

The Hulu (With Ads) + Live TV bundle is $99.99 per month. It gets you the same services — Hulu, Live TV, Disney+ and ESPN Select — all with ads. 

You also have the option to go with the Live TV Only plan for $88.99 per month, which provides access to live content but not to the Hulu streaming library, Disney+ or ESPN Select.

From least to most expensive, here’s how Hulu’s Live TV options break down:

- Live TV Only: $88.99 per month.
- Hulu (with ads), Live TV, Disney+ (with ads) and ESPN Select (with ads): $99.99 per month.
- Hulu (no ads), Live TV, Disney+ (no ads) and ESPN Select (with ads): $109.99 per month.

## Hulu add-ons

Hulu also offers several add-on options. If you have an eligible Hulu plan, you can add the following subscriptions:

- ESPN Select for an additional $13.99 per month.
- HBO Max (with ads) for an additional $10.99 per month.
- HBO Max (without ads) for an additional $18.49 per month.
- Cinemax for an additional $9.99 per month. 
- Paramount+ with Showtime for an additional $13.99 per month. 
- Starz for an additional $11.99 per month.

This tool was created with the assistance of AI. It has been reviewed by our editorial team for accuracy and quality.

## Does Hulu allow password sharing?

Hulu’s current subscriber agreement states: “Unless otherwise permitted by your Service Tier, you may not share your subscription outside of your household.” Household refers to the devices you use at your primary residence. 

## Is Hulu worth it?

It depends on your budget and your favorite shows. 

No matter which Hulu option you go with, you can cancel services, switch plans, or add subscriptions at any time, although charges may apply until the end of your current billing cycle. You may also be able to pause your service. 

To determine which Hulu plan fits your budget, try reviewing the 50/30/20 budget framework, in which 50% of your take-home income is allocated to needs, 30% to wants, and 20% to savings and debt paydown beyond the minimums. A subscription service like Hulu would reside in the wants category.

Going with an ad-supported plan will save some money, but if you’re already maxed out on wants and are hoping for ad-free viewing, consider cutting back elsewhere in the category, such as on travel or eating out.

# Hulu Price Per Month 2026: Every Plan and Bundle

Amit Yadav· October 6, 2026· 11 min read

On this page

1. Hulu plans and what you get
2. The fine print
3. Why the Disney+ bundle beats Hulu alone
4. What Hulu is worth watching for
5. Hulu vs other streaming services
6. Discounts and cheaper ways to pay
7. Hulu price history
8. What subscribers say on Reddit
9. Our verdict
10. FAQs
11. How much is Hulu per month in 2026?
12. Is it cheaper to get Hulu with Disney+?
13. How much is Hulu for students?
14. How much is Hulu + Live TV?
15. Does Hulu have a free trial?
16. Can I download shows on Hulu with ads?
17. Why does Hulu's no-ads plan still show ads?

Hulu costs $12.49 a month with ads and $21.49 a month without ads in the US after Disney's latest price rise. New subscribers pay that now; existing members move on their first bill on or after October 21, 2026. Hulu + Live TV is $99.99 a month with ads.

Here is the twist that most price guides miss: the Disney+ and Hulu bundle with ads costs $12.99, just 50 cents more than Hulu on its own, and the ad-free bundle is $21.99, also 50 cents more than ad-free Hulu. For almost everyone, buying Hulu by itself no longer makes sense. This guide covers every plan, what you actually get, the bundles, student and carrier deals, price history and who should pay for what.

Prices checked October 2, 2026

Prices from Disney's September 23, 2026 US price announcement: Hulu with ads $12.49 (was $11.99), Hulu Premium (no ads) $21.49 (was $18.99), Disney+ and Hulu bundle with ads $12.99 (unchanged), bundle Premium $21.99 (was $19.99), Hulu + Live TV $99.99 with ads or $109.99 without (both up $10). Hulu's US plan page was geo-blocked from our test location, so we confirmed these against multiple reports of Disney's announcement.

The short answer

- Hulu with ads: $12.49 a month. The bundle with Disney+ is $12.99. Buy the bundle.
- Hulu Premium (no ads): $21.49. The ad-free Disney+ and Hulu bundle is $21.99. Again, buy the bundle.
- Students: the Disney+ and Hulu bundle with ads is $6.49; the older $1.99 Hulu-only student plan may not be open to new signups.
- Hulu + Live TV: $99.99 with ads, and it already includes Disney+ and ESPN.
- Hulu has raised prices every October since 2021. Plan on another rise in late 2027.

## Hulu plans and what you get

| | Hulu (with ads) | Hulu Premium (no ads) | Hulu + Live TV |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Monthly price | $12.49 | $21.49 | $99.99 with ads, $109.99 ad-free on-demand |
| Yearly cost | $149.88 | $257.88 | $1,199.88 |
| Ads | Yes | Almost none (see below) | On live channels |
| Screens at once | 2 | 2 | 2 (unlimited with add-on) |
| Downloads | No | Yes | On-demand library only |
| 4K | Select titles | Select titles | Select titles |
| Live channels | No | No | 95+ channels, cloud DVR |
| Includes Disney+ and ESPN | No | No | Yes |

### The fine print

- "No ads" is not quite no ads. A handful of shows on Hulu Premium still play short ads before and after episodes because of licensing deals. Hulu lists them with a "no ads" exception. It is a few titles, not a lot, but it surprises people.
- No downloads on the ad plan. Offline viewing is Premium-only.
- Two screens. Families with three or four TVs need the Unlimited Screens add-on, which is only available with Hulu + Live TV.
- The Hulu app is moving into Disney+. During 2026 Disney is folding Hulu content into the Disney+ app. Standalone Hulu plans are still sold, but more and more of the experience lives in Disney+, which is another reason the bundle makes sense.
- Price rises apply to existing members after a 30-day notice. There is no grandfathering.
